jobs.title: Software Engineer Lead
jobs.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Full-Stack Development
  + Design and implement responsive user interfaces using ReactJS, React Native, HTML, CSS, JavaScript
  + Develop robust back-end services using Java Spring Boot, Python, Node.JS
  + Create and optimize databases (MongoDB, SQL) and APIs for scalability
* Cloud and Deployment
  + Build and deploy solutions on AWS and leverage cloud-native services
  + Implement CI/CD pipelines and automated testing practices
* Agile Delivery
  + Participate in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives)
  + Collaborate with product managers, UX designers, and QA teams to deliver features on time
* Quality and Security
  + Ensure application performance, uptime, and scalability
  + Implement security best practices and compliance standards
* Innovation and AI Integration
  + Contribute to GenAI and AI/ML-driven solutions for digital engagement
  + Work on emerging technologies to support strategic initiatives
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Graduation
* 5+ years of experience in full-stack development
* Solid understanding of front-end and back-end frameworks
* Technical Skills: ReactJS, React Native, Java, Python, MongoDB, GitHub, AWS

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

jobs.description:
QA/QC Manager – Rubber Gaskets & Product Certifications

**Company:** Deesawala Rubber Industries  
**Location:** Hyderabad, Telangana  
**Department:** Quality Assurance & Quality Control  
**Experience:** 5–10 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

Job Summary

Deesawala Rubber Industries is looking for an experienced **QA/QC Manager** with strong hands-on experience in **rubber gasket manufacturing, rubber testing, quality management systems, product certifications, and technical compliance**.

The ideal candidate should have experience with **rubber moulded products and elastomeric sealing products**, particularly pipe gaskets for **GRP/GRP composite pipes and ductile iron (DI) pipes**, flange gaskets, O-rings, and rubber compounds such as **EPDM, FKM (Viton), HNBR**, and other elastomers.

The selected candidate will be responsible for managing quality control activities, laboratory testing, customer and certification audits, product approvals, and continuous improvement of the company's quality systems.

Key Responsibilities1. Quality Control & Testing

* Manage incoming raw material, in-process, and final product inspection and testing.
* Conduct and review rubber testing including **Hardness (Shore A/IRHD), Tensile Strength, Elongation, Compression Set, Ageing Resistance**, and other applicable physical properties.
* Ensure dimensional accuracy, profile conformity, tolerances, and sealing performance of rubber gaskets and O-rings.
* Prepare and implement Inspection & Test Plans (ITP), sampling procedures, acceptance criteria, and product quality standards.
* Maintain laboratory equipment, calibration records, inspection reports, test reports, and Certificates of Analysis.
* Coordinate with accredited external laboratories for specialized testing.

2. Product Certifications & Approvals

* Lead product approval and certification activities for **WRAS, NSF, BIS**, and other applicable certifications.
* Understand applicable certification requirements, test protocols, documentation, and renewal procedures.
* Prepare technical dossiers, product specifications, drawings, material declarations, test reports, and certification documents.
* Coordinate with certification bodies, testing laboratories, and regulatory agencies.
* Manage product sample submissions, factory inspections, corrective actions, and certification renewals.
* Maintain a certification register and ensure timely renewal of approvals.

3. Standards & Technical Compliance

* Interpret and implement applicable **IS, EN, ISO, ASTM**, and customer-specific standards.
* Knowledge of **EN 681-1, IS 5382, ISO 9001** and relevant rubber/elastomer standards will be an advantage.
* Ensure compliance with applicable requirements for potable-water applications.
* Review product specifications and ensure compliance with customer and target-market requirements.

**4. Quality Management System & Audits:**

* Implement and maintain an effective **Quality Management System (QMS)**, preferably ISO 9001.
* Coordinate internal, customer, certification, and third-party audits.
* Manage **NCRs, Root Cause Analysis, Corrective & Preventive Actions (CAPA)** and customer complaints.
* Prepare and maintain SOPs, quality manuals, inspection formats, control plans, and testing procedures.
* Analyse quality data and drive continuous improvement in product quality and process consistency.

5. Manufacturing & Cross-Functional Coordination

* Work closely with **Production, Moulding, Compounding, Purchase, and Dispatch** teams to prevent quality issues.
* Monitor critical manufacturing parameters and ensure consistent quality across batches.
* Approve or recommend disposition of non-conforming materials and finished products.
* Support new product development, rubber compound qualification, process validation, and customer approvals.
* Train production and inspection personnel on quality standards, testing methods, and documentation.

**Required Qualifications:**

* B.Tech / B.E. in **Rubber Technology, Polymer Technology, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering**, or a relevant technical discipline.
* **5–10 years of experience** in QA/QC, preferably in rubber gasket, rubber moulding, elastomeric sealing, or polymer manufacturing.
* Strong practical knowledge of rubber testing methods and interpretation of test results.
* Experience in quality documentation, inspection procedures, and customer quality requirements.
* Experience coordinating with external laboratories and certification agencies.
* Strong analytical, documentation, communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Experience:**

Candidates with experience in the following areas will be strongly preferred:

* Rubber gasket manufacturing for **GRP/GRP composite pipes or ductile iron (DI) pipes**.
* Flange gaskets, O-rings, and elastomeric products.
* **EPDM, FKM (Viton), HNBR** and other rubber compounds.
* WRAS, NSF, BIS or similar product certifications.
* EN 681-1, IS 5382, ISO 9001 and applicable ASTM/ISO/IS standards.
* Customer audits, third-party testing, certification applications, and technical compliance.
* Rubber moulding and elastomeric sealing product manufacturing.

**Key Skills:**

**QA/QC | Rubber Testing | Rubber Gaskets | Rubber Moulding | EPDM | FKM/Viton | HNBR | O-Rings | Pipe Gaskets | Flange Gaskets | ISO 9001 | WRAS | NSF | BIS | EN 681-1 | IS 5382 | ASTM | CAPA | Root Cause Analysis | Customer Audits | Certification Management | Quality Documentation**

jobs.description:

The people here at Apple don't just build products—they craft the kind of wonder that has revolutionized entire industries. It's the diversity of those people and their ideas that encourage the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it! Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here. Customer Systems is part of IS&T and drives the technology behind Apple's customer support experience — from contact center operations to the software powering the iconic Genius Bar. The team also builds and operates AppleCare's online support platform, which handles 6 billion visits per year, delivering seamless, high-quality support to Apple customers around the globe.
  
  
Description
  
  
Build and maintain scalable, high-performance web applications that deliver seamless and intuitive user experiences. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including designers, product managers, and backend engineers to translate product requirements and designs into responsive, accessible, and user-centric interfaces. Write clean, modular, maintainable, and reusable code using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, and modern frontend frameworks such as Vue, Angular, React. Contribute to frontend architecture and engineering best practices while ensuring applications meet performance, accessibility, security, and cross-browser compatibility standards. You will own frontend features end-to-end, from understanding requirements and implementing solutions to testing, debugging, deployment, and production support. You will also participate in code reviews, identify opportunities for improving application performance and reliability, and stay current with evolving web technologies and development practices.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4+ years of professional experience in frontend/web application development.
* Hands-on experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
* Experience with modern frontend frameworks, such as Vue, Angular, React
* Experience building responsive, accessible, and user-centric web applications

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Experience developing reusable UI components and implementing frontend design patterns
* Experience integrating RESTful APIs and working with backend services.
* Experience with frontend state management frameworks such as Redux or equivalent
* Familiarity with frontend build and development tools such as Webpack, Rush, ESLint, and related tooling
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated frontend build and deployment processes.
* Experience with web performance monitoring, profiling, and optimization.
* Experience with modern testing frameworks and tools such as Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, or Playwright.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Agent Development
jobs.description:
Summary
  
  
Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other’s ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It’s the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you’ll do more than join something — you’ll add something. There are countless ways you can contribute here, from working on apple.com to software for digital & physical Apple Stores, from software for Apple Care to Apple-wide systems for identity, operations, recruiting, and people management, from software for Apple data centers to Apple-wide data processing & AI/ML systems. Apple's IS&T team builds the tools, platforms, and services that power the people who build Apple. Our Customer Systems group is reimagining how Apple engineers work through intelligent, autonomous systems — and we're looking for an Agentic AI Developer to help lead that effort.
  
  
Description
  
  
We are looking for a talented Agentic AI Developer to join Apple's IS&T Customer Systems team. In this role, you will design, build, and operate intelligent autonomous agent systems end-to-end — both client-side and server-side. You will architect agents that reason, plan, remember, and act reliably across long-running workflows, with deep attention to memory design, multi-agent orchestration, observability, and maintainability. This is a deeply technical engineering role with a high bar for production quality. You will own the full lifecycle of agentic systems: from agent architecture and memory design, to tool integration, observability, and safe deployment. While the primary focus is agent engineering, a solid understanding of the Java tech stack, React, and TypeScript is also important, as you will work across both server-side and client-side surfaces. You will collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, and platform teams across Apple to bring AI capabilities into the developer tools our teams depend on every day.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* 4+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 2 years focused on AI/ML systems, LLM integrations, or autonomous agent development
* Hands-on experience designing and implementing multi-agent orchestration systems and agent loop patterns (ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, or similar)
* Strong proficiency in Java (Spring Boot) and TypeScript/React for building full-stack agentic applications
* Solid understanding of LLM fundamentals: prompt engineering, context window management, function calling, structured outputs, and tool use
* Experience building RAG pipelines and working with vector databases .
* Demonstrated ability to implement agent safety guardrails including prompt-injection defences and output schema enforcement
* Experience with observability tooling (OpenTelemetry or equivalent) applied to distributed, AI-driven systems
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field .

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Experience implementing or consuming MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and clients
* Familiarity with model routing and fallback strategies across multiple LLM providers
* Reactive programming in Java — Project Reactor, WebFlux — for streaming LLM responses
* Python proficiency for agent prototyping and evaluation pipeline scripting
* Hands-on experience with cloud AI platforms .
* Experience with agent sandboxing and safe code execution environments
* Awareness of fine-tuning, LoRA, and small-model distillation techniques for agent specialisation

jobs.title: Senior Hardware Product Manager - IoT Wireless
jobs.description:
Silicon Labs (NASDAQ: SLAB) is the leading innovator in low-power wireless connectivity, building embedded technology that connects devices and improves lives. Merging cutting-edge technology into the world’s most highly integrated SoCs, Silicon Labs provides device makers the solutions, support, and ecosystems needed to create advanced edge connectivity applications. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, Silicon Labs has operations in over 16 countries and is the trusted partner for innovative solutions in the smart home, industrial IoT, and smart cities markets. Learn more at www.silabs.com.

**Meet the Team**

IoT is the only focus area for Silicon Labs and is one of the most visible and fastest growing segments of the semiconductor industry. Our portfolio of industry leading wireless solutions includes Bluetooth, Zigbee, Thread, Z-Wave, Wi-Fi, Wi-Sun, Proprietary Wireless and other emerging technologies driving the next generation of IoT smart connected products. With the addition of AI acceleration, rich MCU content combined with best-in-class software stacks, tools and development environments we offer compulsive and complete solutions to customers.

As a member of the Hardware Product Management team, you will be responsible for the Silicon Labs IoT products starting from concept to plan and customer alphas. You will be required to interact with a wide range of cross functional teams including silicon design, product test, validation, software product management & engineering, project management and business management to ensure the best of the products come to the market.

As a team, hardware product management:

* Provides leadership and vision on IC product roadmap and requirements.
* Continuously improves our portfolio offering, balancing business needs with R&D efficiency.
* Creates product roadmaps based on various segment inputs to meet the requirements for a diverse range of applications

This is one of the few functions where you will have the great opportunity to discuss with top executives regarding strategy and execution on a day-to-day basis, thus having invaluable amount of learning.

Come and join us in our goal to become the undisputed leader in wireless connectivity for IoT!

**Responsibilities**

* Define SoC product requirements, features, specifications, and system KPIs for core CPU, co-processors, accelerators, power management, digital and analog peripherals, security sub-system, radio sub-system, and packages.
* Map market systems application requirements to product use cases, including system block diagrams, compute and peripheral requirements, and protocol stack features and performance requirements for Wi-Fi, Matter, Thread, ZigBee, Bluetooth Low Energy, Bluetooth Classic, Sidewalk, Wi-SUN, and proprietary protocols.
* Define hardware and evaluation tools for customers, including debug interfaces such as JTAG, SWD, ETM trace, PTI, virtual communication port requirements, and user interfaces such as push buttons, LCDs, LEDs, analog joysticks, and RHT sensors.
* Collaborate with leaders and individual contributors across functional teams such as IC design, product test, software development, product and segment marketing, applications, operations, and sales to develop long-term innovation ideas, roadmap, and silicon definition.
* Drive the product development process from concept through definition and pitch the most promising product ideas to executive staff.

**Skills You Will Need**

*Minimum Qualifications*

* BSEE/BSCS (or equivalent) and 6+ years of experience in semiconductor product management or IoT industry
* Core development experience in IC front end / architecture / verification / embedded systems

jobs.description:
**Company Description**
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
  
  
**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
  
  
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
  
  
**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
More about
**our mission**
and
**what we offer**
.
  
  
Wise is building the best way to move and manage money across borders. To make that possible, customers need to be able to join Wise quickly, safely, and confidently.
  
  
We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager to join our Onboarding & KYC team in Hyderabad. You’ll own high-impact product work across APAC, helping Wise build onboarding and verification experiences that are low-friction for customers and prevent financial crime.
  
  
This is a senior role for someone who can operate in ambiguity, get deep into customer, regulatory, data, and technical details, and turn complex problems into shipped product outcomes.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Own product strategy and roadmap for APAC onboarding, KYC and financial crime mitigation initiatives, from discovery through delivery, launch, measurement, and iteration.
* Build and scale digital identity verification and eKYC experiences across markets such as Japan, Singapore, Australia, New Zealand, Thailand, Malaysia, Hong Kong, and the Philippines.
* Partner with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Operations, Risk & Compliance to balance conversion, customer experience, operational cost, regulatory requirements and financial crime risk.
* Lead complex localisation work, including integrating local identity providers, registry checks, and APAC-specific controls into Wise’s global platform.
* Improve customer onboarding outcomes such as first product adoption, verification completion, time-to-verify, manual review rates, cost-to-serve, and quality of fincrime decisions.
* Mitigating risk of financial crime by ensuring our in-product control environment accounts for country-specific financial crime risks.
* Use data, customer insight, operational feedback, and regulatory context to prioritise what matters most.
* Help generalise APAC’s strongest onboarding and KYC capabilities so they can be reused by other Wise product teams.
* Staying close to the details: customer journeys, dashboards, service architecture, regulatory interpretations, edge cases, incidents, and operational workflows.

**Qualifications**
**What we’re looking for**

* Significant product management experience, ideally in finance/fintech, identity, onboarding, KYC, risk, compliance, fraud, trust & safety, or another regulated domain.

+ 8+ years in the workforce with ideally 5+ years in product management or product-management adjacent roles.
+ For those with material experience outside of product management we still require a minimum of 3+ years in a senior product manager role

* A strong track record shipping customer-facing products end-to-end, not just writing strategy.
* Excellent structured problem solving: you can break down ambiguous, multi-stakeholder problems and create a practical path to impact.
* Strong analytical skills: you can define good metrics, interrogate data, work with SQL (or similar), and make trade-offs based on evidence.
* Enough technical depth to work with engineers on systems, integrations, reliability, observability, and platform design.
* Strong customer focus, including a habit of using customer research, support insights, funnel data, and operational feedback to shape product decisions.
* Clear, concise communication and the ability to influence senior stakeholders without relying on authority.
* High ownership, strong attention to detail, and willingness to roll up your sleeves,

**Nice to have**

* Experience with KYC/KYB: digital identity, national ID systems, government registry integrations, biometric or document verification, business onboarding,
* Experience in financial crime prevention: risk models (e.g. machine learning models), fraud/scam product prevention
* Experience launching products across multiple countries or adapting global platforms to local market requirements.
* Experience working with distributed teams across product, engineering, compliance, operations, and regional leadership.

**Location**
This role is based in Hyderabad, working closely with teams across Singapore, other APAC markets and Wise’s global product and engineering hubs.
  
  
Additional Information
  
  
For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
  
  
We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
  
  
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
  
  
If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Supply Chain
jobs.description:
At FirstClub, we are building a new kind of quick commerce from the ground up, and the supply chain is where that promise is won or lost. The Supply Chain Product team builds the systems that decide what we buy, where it sits, how it moves and what we promise each member. Every order that reaches a member on time, fresh and complete is the output of our products.

  

**The team's charter spans the full supply chain:**

  

- Buying & Sourcing: demand-led purchase planning, vendor management, PO lifecycle and inbound scheduling.

  

- Collection Centers: first-mile intake, quality checks, grading and consolidation of fresh and farm produce.

  

- Distribution Centers (DCs): inbound, putaway, storage, picking, packing, outbound and returns.

  

- Middle Mile: DC-to-Club House replenishment, trip planning, vehicle utilization and inventory movement.

  

- Club Houses: receiving, storage, pick-pack, cycle counts, freshness and wastage control.

  

- Inventory Management: single source of truth for stock, ageing and expiry, replenishment and inventory accuracy across nodes.

  

- Capacity Management: labor, slot, storage and throughput planning across nodes and time of day.

  

- Promise Engine: what we promise each member availability and delivery ETA based on live inventory and capacity.

  

**Why FirstClub**

  

- Build, don't babysit: Much of our supply chain stack is being built right now. You will design core systems, not just tune someone else's.

  

- Small team, big surface area: You'll own outcomes that would sit with a whole team at a larger company.

  

- Fast loops: Ship on Monday, watch it run on a Club House floor by Wednesday, improve it by Friday.

  

- Ground truth over slide decks: Our PMs spend real time in DCs, Collection Centers and Club Houses, not just in dashboards.

  

- Scrappy beats perfect: We'd rather run a pilot this week than polish a plan for next quarter.

  

- Your fingerprints on the company: The decisions you make now shape how FirstClub scales to every new city.

  

**The role**

  

As a Senior Product Manager, you will own the end-to-end supply chain product charter at FirstClub from how we source and buy, through Collection Centers, DCs and the middle mile, to inventory in our Club Houses and the promise we make each member. Your mandate is to build a high-control, intelligent and scalable supply chain that improves availability, freshness and speed while driving down cost per order and wastage.

  

This isn't a role where you inherit a mature platform and keep it running. You'll build core pieces of FirstClub's supply chain while the business grows around them: making calls with incomplete data, getting your hands dirty on the floor, and setting how product works across the charter. You'll shape how inventory moves across the network, how frontline teams work, and how FirstClub scales to new cities without losing control or quality.

  

**What you will do**

  

- Own the product vision, strategy and roadmap across Buying & Sourcing, Collection Centers, DCs, Middle Mile, Club Houses, Inventory Management, Capacity Management and the Promise Engine.

  

- Set and own the north-star metrics for the charter: availability and fill rate, promise adherence (promised vs. actual), inventory accuracy, days of inventory, wastage and shrinkage, cost per order and throughput per node.

  

- Partner deeply with Supply Chain, Category, Operations and Finance leadership to find the biggest ground-level problems and convert them into a prioritised, outcome-driven roadmap.

  

- Architect the core systems with Engineering: a single source of truth for inventory across nodes, a demand-led buying and replenishment engine, and a Promise Engine that balances availability, capacity and speed in real time.

  

- Build capacity planning across labour, slots, storage and vehicles, so the network flexes for peaks, new categories and new cities.

  

- Own the frontline tooling strategy for associates, site managers, QC teams and transport partners making work simpler, faster and measurable, including productivity tracking and incentives.

  

- Lead build-vs-buy decisions across WMS, TMS, procurement and planning systems, and drive integrations with vendors and 3P partners.

  

- Treat AI and automation as first principles, not add-ons: forecasting, auto-replenishment, intelligent allocation, anomaly and shrinkage detection, and agentic workflows that remove manual decisions from planners and site teams.

  

- Run a strong experimentation and measurement culture pilots by node or city, clear success criteria, and rigorous readouts.

  

- Lead, coach and grow a team of Product Managers, raising the bar on problem framing, execution, stakeholder management and ground-level empathy.

  

- Help shape the operating model for scaling FirstClub's supply chain across cities with high reliability and healthy unit economics.

  

**What we are looking for**

  

- 5 to 8 years of Product Management experience, with a track record of owning and scaling products with measurable business impact.

  

- Experience leading or mentoring Product Managers, and happy to be a player-coach who still owns hands-on product work.

  

- Deep experience in supply chain, warehousing, quick commerce, e-commerce, grocery, food delivery or logistics, ideally across more than one node of the chain.

  

- Strong understanding of inventory planning, replenishment, warehouse operations, middle-mile logistics, capacity planning or delivery promise systems.

  

- Experience building products with a significant frontline or ground operations component.

  

- Proven ability to move operational and financial metrics such as fill rate, wastage, cost per order, productivity and SLA adherence.

  

- Strong analytical depth: comfortable with SQL, experimentation and working alongside Data Science on forecasting and optimisation problems.

  

- An AI-native mindset: you think naturally ab…

You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.

The Scrum Master is a key member of an Agile team, responsible for facilitating the Scrum process, coaching team members in Agile best practices, and ensuring the teams effectiveness in delivering high-quality products. The Scrum Master acts as a servant leader, removing impediments and fostering a collaborative, transparent, and high-performing team environment.

* Support backlog refinement, prioritization, and communication of delivery goals in collaboration with Product Owners and cross-functional stakeholders.

* Experience coaching Product Owners, Scrum Masters, and development teams on Agile practices, Lean delivery practices, and product delivery tools.
* Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Technology, Master of Computer Applications, or Master of Science in Computer Science from an accredited university, or equivalent degree.

Preferred:

* SAFe Agilist certification.
* Experience working with cross-functional teams in enterprise-scale delivery environments.
* Experience tracking sprint plan, definition of done, quality, and delivery flow metrics.
* Experience supporting backlog refinement and backlog management with Product Owners.
* Experience with version control systems, including GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket, and continuous integration, continuous deployment, and release management processes.
* Experience using objectives and key results and key performance indicators to measure Agile team performance.

**Job Description Product Manager, Cross-Border FX & Payments Product**

  

**Role & responsibilities:**

  

You will be the first dedicated Product Manager for this new product line. This is a 0-to-1 role: there is a clear market opportunity, a capable engineering team and early API work, but no defined product yet.

You will take it from customer discovery to a launched MVP. That means defining who we serve, what problems we solve for them, what we build first, and how engineering delivers it. You will work closely with our Solutions team, Solution Architect, Engineering Manager, and commercial leadership.

* **Title:** Product Manager
* **Location:** Hybrid / Remote
* **Employment type:** Full-time

  

**What you'll do**

  

**Discover and define the product**

* Run customer discovery with bank clients, fintechs and internal Solutions teams to understand cross-border payment, FX and multi-currency account needs.
* Build personas for the buyers and users we serve, such as treasury teams, payment operations, finance controllers and integration developers.
* Map end-to-end journeys: onboarding and KYC, wallet and account setup, FX conversion, payouts, collections, reconciliation and reporting.
* Translate the underlying FX and payments capabilities into a clear value proposition for our clients, and decide where Axletree adds value on top.

**Shape strategy and roadmap**

* Write the product vision, problem statements and success metrics for the product line.
* Define the MVP scope and a phased roadmap beyond it, with clear trade-offs and rationale.
* Work with commercial leadership on packaging, pricing inputs and go-to-market readiness.
* Track the competitive landscape, including other FX and cross-border payment providers.

  

**Turn strategy into buildable work**

* Break the product down from personas to epics, features and user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
* Own and prioritize the backlog in Jira, and keep Confluence documentation current.
* Meet the team's Definition of Ready before work enters a sprint, and take part in grooming, sprint reviews and demos.
* Partner with the Solution Architect and engineers on API design, workflows and edge cases without dictating the solution.

  

**Launch and learn**

* Coordinate MVP launch, client pilots and go-to-market sign-off with Solutions, Sales, Compliance and Support.
* Define and track product KPIs such as client activation, transaction volume, FX revenue and time to first payment.
* Feed what clients tell us back into the roadmap.

  

**Preferred candidate profile**

* 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years in payments, fintech or banking technology.
* A track record of taking a product from zero to launch, including discovery, MVP definition and first release.
* Working knowledge of cross-border payments and FX: multi-currency accounts, conversions, payouts, collections, settlement and reconciliation.
* Comfort with API-first, B2B or B2B2X products sold to banks or financial institutions.
* Strong product craft: personas, journey mapping, problem framing, prioritization frameworks, and well-written user stories with acceptance criteria.
* Hands-on experience with Jira and Confluence, and with working inside Agile/Scrum teams.
* Enough technical fluency to read API documentation, discuss data models and integration flows, and hold your own with architects and engineers.
* Clear written and verbal communication with clients, executives and engineers alike.
* Comfort with ambiguity and a habit of creating structure where none exists.

  

**Nice to have**

* Direct experience building on or integrating with third-party FX and payment providers.
* Familiarity with SWIFT, ISO 20022 or other payment messaging standards.
* Exposure to compliance topics such as KYC/KYB, AML, safeguarding and licensing across regions.
* Experience working with banking clients through long, multi-stakeholder sales and onboarding cycles.
* Experience defining pricing or commercial models for transaction-based products.
* A background in engineering, business analysis or solutions consulting.

jobs.title: Business Analyst – Data In-Licensing & Data Governance
jobs.description:
**Job Description: Business Analyst**
– Data In-Licensing & Data Governance Role: Business Analyst – Data In-Licensing & Data Governance Domain: Life Sciences / Pharmaceutical R&D Engagement Focus: Current-State Assessment, Gap Analysis, Requirements Definition & Future State Roadmap Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst with strong knowledge of data governance, data licensing, data lifecycle management, and enterprise data management practices to support an assessment of the Data In-Licensing process within Novartis Biomedical Research (NIBR). The individual will work closely with business, scientific research, data management, legal, procurement, compliance, and technology stakeholders to assess the current operating model, identify process and technology gaps, and recommend improvements to strengthen governance, compliance, traceability, and operational efficiency across the licensed data lifecycle. Key
**Responsibilities**

1. Data In-Licensing Process Assessment Analyze the end-to-end data in-licensing lifecycle, from data acquisition and contractual agreements through onboarding, provisioning, consumption, renewal, expiry, and retirement. Conduct stakeholder interviews and workshops to understand the current operating model, systems, responsibilities, and pain points. Identify manual activities, fragmented workflows, unclear ownership, and opportunities for automation. Prepare AS-IS process maps, gap assessments, and recommended TO-BE workflows.

2. Data Bill of Materials (DBoM) and License Management Define business requirements for a centralized Data Bill of Materials to track all licensed datasets. Identify essential metadata, including data provider, dataset ownership, licensing terms, permitted usage, restrictions, contractual obligations, renewal dates, expiration timelines, and retention requirements. Assess current mechanisms for tracking licensed datasets and their downstream dependencies. Define requirements for notifications, license renewals, compliance checkpoints, and expiry management.

3. Access Governance and Entitlement Management Assess existing Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and entitlement management processes. Map user roles, access privileges, approval workflows, and data usage restrictions to contractual requirements. Identify gaps in access approvals, access reviews, and entitlement revocation. Define business requirements for visibility into who accesses licensed datasets, for what purpose, and under which permissions.

4. Data Lifecycle and Retention Management Evaluate existing practices for data retention, archival, expiration, and secure deletion. Translate contractual retention and deletion obligations into actionable business requirements. Identify gaps in handling expired licenses, downstream copies, and derived datasets. Define requirements for deletion workflows, approvals, exception handling, and evidence of deletion.

5. Auditability, Data Lineage, and Compliance Assess the organization's ability to trace licensed data from acquisition to consumption. Define requirements for audit trails, usage monitoring, and end-to-end data lineage. Identify gaps in demonstrating compliance with contractual usage restrictions and internal governance policies. Work with risk, legal, and compliance stakeholders to define reporting and audit evidence requirements.

6. Gap Analysis and Future-State Recommendations Consolidate findings into a structured gap assessment covering people, process, technology, and governance. Prioritize gaps based on business impact, contractual exposure, operational risk, and implementation complexity. Develop business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and a prioritized improvement backlog. Collaborate with the Data Engineer and solution architects to define feasible remediation options and a phased implementation roadmap.

**Required Skills and Experience**

• 6–10 years of Business Analysis experience, preferably in pharmaceutical, life sciences, research data, or regulated enterprise environments.

• Experience with data governance, data management, data cataloging, and metadata management.

• Understanding of data licensing, contractual data usage restrictions, and third-party data management.

• Strong knowledge of RBAC, access governance, data lifecycle management, and audit requirements.

• Experience with business process mapping, stakeholder workshops, gap assessments, and requirements documentation.

• Familiarity with SQL, relational databases, data lineage concepts, and enterprise data architectures.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Skills**

• Exposure to pharmaceutical R&D or scientific research data ecosystems.

• Experience with data governance/catalog platforms such as Collibra, Informatica, Alation, or equivalent.

• Understanding of GDPR, retention policies, contractual compliance, and internal data governance standards.

• Experience working with Jira, Confluence, Visio, or BPMN modeling tools.

**Expected Deliverables**

• Current-State Data In-Licensing Process Assessment.

• Stakeholder and System Interaction Mapping.

• End-to-End Process and Governance Gap Analysis.

• DBoM Business Requirements and Metadata Definition.

• Access Control, Entitlement, Retention, and Deletion Requirements.

• Auditability and Data Traceability Requirements.

• Future-State Process Recommendations.

• Prioritized Business Requirements and Remediation Roadmap. Primary Outcome: A comprehensive understanding of business and governance gaps, with actionable recommendations to establish an efficient, compliant, and traceable data in-licensing process.

jobs.description:
Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us.

Itron Resiliency Solutions is an innovative business unit within Itron focused on solving mission critical problems for utilities through software and AI. Resiliency Solutions offers unique, market leading solutions for front-line worker safety, storm response, excavation damage prevention, construction management, and many more. These software and AI solutions solve end-to-end challenges for the utilities that power our society and are used by the largest and most complex organizations in the world such as National Grid, Southern Company, and Exelon.

Itron Resiliency Solutions is a global, diverse team of builders and innovators who tackle previously impossible challenges for our customers. If you have a desire to challenge yourself, solve impactful problems, and work with a passionate and talented team, this is the place.

The Emergency Preparedness & Response (EP&R) team builds the systems that keep critical operations running when it matters most. When storms and severe weather threaten communities and infrastructure across the US, our platform enables customers to rapidly procure, mobilize, and manage the workforce needed to respond to and recover from storm damage — often under tight timelines and high-stakes conditions. We are looking for a Principal Engineer who is deeply hands-on, works backward from customer pain points and business needs, and measures success by impact rather than lines of code shipped. You will be the technical anchor of the team: a backend-heavy full-stack engineer who knows our systems inside and out, reasons rigorously about trade-offs, and raises the engineering bar for everyone around you while leading the team toward outcomes that genuinely matter.

**About the role**
------------------

We're hiring a Software Engineer in Bengaluru to build and run production services. You'll own features end to end — from understanding the problem to shipping, monitoring and fixing what you built — with growing independence and support from senior engineers.

Our India engineering team is taking full ownership of core products and growing quickly, including a ground-up rebuild of a customer-critical service. You'll work closely with senior engineers, your Engineering Manager, Product and Customer Support.

**What you'll own in your first year**
--------------------------------------

* **Own:** Own features and services end to end with speed and quality — build, test, release, monitor, fix.
* **Well-scoped problems, then bigger ones.** Start with clearly defined work and grow into breaking down ambiguous problems yourself.
* **Design.** Write design notes for your features and get them reviewed; contribute to larger designs led by senior engineers.
* **Quality.** Write tests, add observability, and take part in on-call so issues are caught before customers see them.
* **Customers.** Understand who uses what you build, and learn from support issues what to fix next.
* **Code reviews.** Give and receive thoughtful reviews, and help onboard engineers who join after you.

**What you must bring**
-----------------------

These are the bar. We can't teach them on the job.

* **Experience:** 1–4 years building production software. We level on demonstrated scope, not years alone.
* **You've shipped code that runs in production.** Features or services you built, released and supported — not only coursework or prototypes.
* **You are strong at problem solving.** You can take an unfamiliar, feature-sized problem, reason through it, and land on a simple, correct solution.
* **You work independently toward a clear goal.** Given a clear goal, you figure out the steps, unblock yourself, and ask for help at the right moments.

We care how you engineer more than which language you did it in.

**Technical background**
------------------------

You've built production software with a modern stack, such as:

* **Cloud:** hands-on with AWS — you've deployed and debugged services running on it.
* **Languages:** strong in at least one modern language such as Python, Java or JavaScript/TypeScript.
* **Frameworks:** modern service frameworks such as FastAPI, Node.js or equivalents.
* **Databases:** solid data modeling and query fundamentals — you can design a schema, use indexes well, and explain why a query is slow and how you'd fix it.
* **Fundamentals:** data structures, API design, and the basics of caching and concurrency.

Exact tools matter less than depth. Strong experience on an equivalent stack is welcome.

**What sets great candidates apart**
------------------------------------

* **Impact you can explain.** You can say what changed because of something you built — for users, performance or reliability.
* **One problem you went deep on.** A bug, a performance issue or a design where you dug past the surface to understand why.
* **Ownership beyond the ticket.** You've fixed what you shipped when it broke, and improved it after release without being asked.
* **Framework mindset:** You notice repeated code and turn it into something reusable.
* **Learning speed.** You've picked up a new domain, codebase or technology quickly and delivered in it.
* **Curiosity about the user.** You've asked why a requirement exists, or suggested a simpler way to solve the user's problem.

**What we look for in everyone we hire**
----------------------------------------

Whatever the role, we hire for six things.

* **Customer obsession.** You care who uses what you build and whether it actually helped them.
* **Impact over activity.** You measure success by outcomes, not tickets closed or lines written.
* **Honesty.** You're specific about your own part in team work, raise problems early, and say what didn't work.
* **Independence.** You don't wait to be told every next step. You figure things out with little hand-holding…

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About the role**  
  
We are hiring a Product Manager — Household Data Products to own a portfolio of data products within Target's Household product line: from household definitions and taxonomy, through certified datasets, pipelines, quality and governance, to the applications that Media, Promotions, Merchandising and Loyalty teams use to make decisions.  
  
Household is how Target understands its guests as the real-world units that shop together. This role takes the household foundation and turns it into trusted, reusable data products and decision-ready applications — answering questions like which households we acquired, retained or reactivated, what drove it, and how we should market, promote and assort for them.  
  
This is a hands-on role that works closely with Data Engineering, Analytics, Data Science, Identity and business partners. You will partner with DE day-to-day across a medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) architecture, shape schemas and data contracts, and make sure household data products are trusted, well-governed and adopted. The core job is to translate technical capability into business outcomes.  
  
**What you’ll own**  
  
**Household Foundations – Must Have**  
  
You will help build and own the household foundation layer that every downstream use case depends on: stable, certified household datasets built on the enterprise household identity (owned by the Identity team), with consistent definitions that business partners can trust and reuse.

* Household lifecycle definitions and formats — acquisition, retention, reactivation and new-to-category — agreed with Analytics and Finance and published as certified data products.
* Household attributes and taxonomy — life stage, composition, demographics, interests and purchase behaviour, including third-party enrichment — with clear ownership, lineage and refresh cadence.
* Household-level enterprise KPIs such as household-based conversion, taken from definition through UAT, sign-off and production.

**Household Applications – Must Have**  
  
You will help turn the foundation into applications that change decisions across the enterprise, delivering against a roadmap shaped with your manager and business partners:

* Media — map household cohorts to the campaigns they were exposed to, starting with diagnostics and extending to Roundel (retail media) audiences and measurement.
* Promotions — connect households to promotion performance so promo teams can see who a promotion actually reached and moved.
* Merchandising — household views of newness-led acquisition and assortment relevancy by life stage.
* Enterprise growth — an acquisition and reactivation waterfall across drivers (marketing including Roundel, promotions, brand marketing, newness and assortment, new stores), plus who the acquired households are.

**Analytics & Data Fluency — Must Have**  
  
Strong working knowledge of analytics and data concepts, with the ability to partner effectively with Analytics and Data Science teams. You should be comfortable with:

* Household and guest-level analytics, cohorts and segmentation
* Entity resolution and identity concepts (guest-to-household mapping, match rates, stability)
* Data aggregation and dimensional modelling
* Data quality, reconciliation and metric definitions in a semantic layer
* Privacy, consent and responsible use of guest and household data

**Building data products with Data Engineering**  
  
You work hand-in-hand with Data Engineering to turn requirements into real datasets and pipelines — translating business needs into clear specs and data contracts, prioritising the backlog, and making trade-off calls with DE on design, cost and sequencing.  
  
**Platform & ecosystem stewardship**  
  
Solid understanding of our data platform and cloud environment (GCP, BigQuery, Power BI). You make household data easy to discover, access and consume — through the certified gold layer, documented data products and self-serve paths for analysts and downstream platforms.  
  
**Trust, governance & data quality — critical**  
  
Data governance and data quality are central to this role, not an afterthought. Household data drives audience targeting, measurement and executive reporting, so an unstable household ID or a wrong definition ripples across every team that uses it. You own certification, quality monitoring, access and consent controls for the household product line.  
  
**Stakeholder partnership**  
  
You will work with partners across Marketing, Roundel, Loyalty, Promotions and Merchandising to gather requirements, clarify competing asks, and communicate progress, trade-offs and impact clearly to stakeholders and leadership.  
  
**What you’ll bring**

* 3–5 years in product management (or 5+ years in closely related data, analytics or engineering roles with product exposure), with experience on customer or household data products, CDP / customer 360, identity, data platforms, or AdTech/MarTech and retail media.
* Strong understanding of customer and household analytics — lifecycle (acquisition, retention, reactivation), segmentation, cohorts and life-stage modelling.
* Familiarity with identity resolution and householding concepts, and with how household data powers audiences, measurement and personalisation.
* Hands-on experience working closely with Data Engineering to build datasets and pipelines — writing specs, shaping schemas and contracts, and prioritising a technical backlog.
* Solid understanding of medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold) and modern data platforms (lakehouse, data mesh or federated architectures), including lineage and cost.
* Strong grasp of data governance and data quality — certification, monitoring, access, privacy and consent — treated as critical, not optional.
* Experience translating technical capability into measurable business outcomes and working effectively with cross-functional partners without direct authority.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Platform and Gateway
jobs.description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Job Description**
Visa's Client Platforms and Enterprise Tools team owns the platforms that govern how clients and partners securely connect to Visa's APIs. As Sr. Product Manager, you will drive product strategy and execution for the Visa Developer Platform's API Gateways, the encryption and key management capabilities that protect data in transit, and Visa's India data localization operations. Direct product strategy from product conception and definition through implementation. Identifies new business and market opportunities and creates appropriate business plans
  
  
All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own product strategy and the long-term roadmap for the Inbound API Gateway and its associated developer portal onboarding flows
* Define the roadmap for authentication and encryption mechanisms supported at the gateway (mTLS, PQC, OAuth, JWT/JWK) and prioritize new auth capabilities against client and regulatory demand
* Own security configuration capabilities such as header whitelisting, and prioritize enhancements based on emerging threat models and client requirements
* Run front-door intake meetings and prioritize incoming feature, security, and integration requests from internal product teams and partners
* Manage the regional deployment roadmap, ensuring gateway capabilities and security configurations are rolled out consistently across regions
* Partner with security, cryptography, and platform engineering teams to validate that new authentication and encryption capabilities meet Visa's security and compliance bar
* Define and track performance key results (latency, availability, onboarding time, auth failure rates) to ensure ongoing product readiness
* Own documentation and enablement materials so internal teams and partners can self-serve gateway onboarding and configuration
* Monitor support/incident trends related to authentication and security configuration, feeding recurring issues back into the roadmap
* Present roadmap, KPIs, and key security/compliance decisions to leadership and governance forums on a recurring cadence
* Support daily operational needs requiring data access and retrieval by India-localized personnel, ensuring timely turnaround for internal and client requests
* Help ensure India-localized platforms and tools run reliably as a cohesive product suite, coordinating fixes and improvements across the underlying systems

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Basic Qualifications:
  
  

* - 9 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree, or 7 or more years of relevant experience with an Advanced Degree, or 3 or more years of experience with a PhD
* - Proven experience as a Product Manager owning API platforms, gateways, or security/authentication infrastructure
* Working knowledge of API authentication and security standards (OAuth, mTLS, JWT/JWK) and emerging areas such as post-quantum cryptography
* Familiarity with encryption concepts (message-level and field-level encryption) and key management lifecycle practices
* Experience running intake/prioritization processes and setting product roadmaps for multiple concurrent workstreams
* Experience partnering closely with security and cryptography engineering teams on regulated or compliance-sensitive capabilities
* Understanding of data localization or data residency regulatory requirements is a plus
* Strong stakeholder management skills across product, engineering, security, and compliance partners
* Comfortable working with agile frameworks such as Scrum or Kanban

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Technology is one of the most important parts of our business. Whether it’s supporting our songwriters, ensuring we provide the right royalty data to global partners, or helping our creative teams use the latest AI tools to discover new talent, technology plays an invaluable role in our success. Product Managers help turn vision into reality.
  
  
We are looking for a Product Manager to partner with a local in-person engineering team in Bengaluru focused on music distribution. Distribution is the vital link between music creation and a fan’s headphones, ensuring our music reaches platforms like Spotify and YouTube globally while protecting the complex rights that ensure our artists get paid. You will be a "user-first" thinker who is responsible for a portfolio of features and products, navigating the high-stakes world of global rights, supply chain automation, and high-scale digital delivery.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Continuous Discovery: Build deep empathy for our labels, operations teams, and global partners by maintaining a constant dialogue with them. Uncover their underlying pain points, ensuring that every solution we build truly solves their problems and makes their daily workflows more seamless.
* Strategy & Roadmap: Define and communicate the long-term vision and roadmap for your products, ensuring they align with WMG’s broader tech strategy.
* Product Trio Collaboration: Work in a "Product Trio" alongside Engineering and Design to solve complex problems, resolving trade-offs and tackling risks.
* Execution & Ownership: Serve as the primary author of PRDs and the "executor-in-chief" for your projects, driving development from ideation through technical delivery.
* Launch & Impact: Develop comprehensive go-to-market strategies, including product positioning, internal messaging, and launch plans. You don't just "ship" code; you ensure the organization is ready to adopt it to achieve maximum impact.
* Analytical Optimization: Continuously monitor product performance metrics, user feedback, and market trends. Use this data to make informed prioritization decisions, identify areas for improvement, and manage technical debt to optimize the product over its entire lifecycle.

**Who You Are**

* Experienced: You have at least 5 years of product management experience, ideally with exposure to the music business or other digital media.
* Technical & Business Savvy: You can discuss system architecture with engineers and business constraints with executives, mitigating Value, Usability, Feasibility, and Business Viability risks upfront.
* A Master Storyteller: You own the "Why" and can easily adjust your communication style for different audiences, from developers to more senior stakeholders.
* Biased to Action: You have a proven ability to unstick a team, make difficult prioritization decisions, and navigate the ambiguity of a global business.
* Humble Leader: You have strong opinions, held weakly; you are quick to share credit with your team and accept responsibility when things don’t go as planned.
* Mission-Driven: You are a music fan motivated by the fact that your work directly impacts an artist’s ability to grow their career and get paid.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Part Of**
Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.
  
  
What you'll be responsible for
  
  
You will own product areas within Managed Payments, Circle’s regulated payments infrastructure that enables PSPs, financial institutions, banks, and enterprises to use stablecoin-powered payment rails without operating crypto infrastructure themselves. You will define and evolve product capabilities that support managed pay-ins, payouts, conversion, and transaction lifecycle management across stablecoin and fiat endpoints. Working closely with Engineering, Compliance, Operations, Treasury, and commercial teams, you will translate complex customer and business needs into clear product priorities, lead cross-functional execution, and deliver measurable improvements to how customers move money across geographies and payment rails.
  
  
What you'll work on
  
  

* Own the roadmap for product areas across managed pay-ins, payouts, fiat endpoints, conversion, and transaction lifecycle management, aligning priorities with customer needs and Circle’s goals.
* Define and launch capabilities that expand Managed Payments across Circle’s regulated hubs, including new entities, corridors, payout methods, and geographic coverage.
* Shape simple, reliable customer experiences for accepting funds, converting value, and disbursing globally across stablecoin and fiat rails, including integrations with CPN and other Circle systems.
* Improve customer and operator workflows across onboarding, account setup, transaction visibility, reporting, exception handling, reconciliation, refunds, RFIs, and bulk payments.
* Use customer, product, payment, and operational data to identify friction, prioritize investments, and measure improvements in reliability, efficiency, adoption, and customer experience.
* Evaluate opportunities to support new payment rails, payout use cases, and digital assets based on customer demand, regulatory requirements, technical feasibility, and business priorities.
* Lead complex cross-functional initiatives with Engineering, Compliance, Operations, Legal, Treasury, BD, and Product, navigating technical and business trade-offs and driving alignment from definition through launch.

What you'll bring to Circle
  
  
Core requirements
  
  

* 4+ years of relevant experience, including product management experience building payments, fintech, financial infrastructure, or similarly complex B2B products.
* Experience owning product vision, roadmaps, and execution for B2B capabilities such as payments, pay-ins, payouts, settlement, treasury infrastructure, APIs, or financial operations.
* Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex cross-functional initiatives spanning Engineering and partners such as Compliance, Operations, Legal, Treasury, or commercial teams.
* Strong analytical and technical fluency, with experience using customer, product, payment, and operational data to identify opportunities and guide product decisions.
* Track record of delivering measurable improvements to customer experience, product adoption, operational efficiency, reliability, or business performance.
* Ability to evaluate technical and business trade-offs, resolve ambiguity, and translate complex requirements into clear product priorities and execution plans.

**Preferred Requirements**

* Knowledge of cross-border payments, PSP infrastructure, settlement systems, correspondent banking, or other payment network concepts.
* Familiarity with stablecoins, blockchain-based financial infrastructure, or crypto-enabled payment systems.
* Experience with enterprise APIs, payment networks, or compliance-forward systems involving payment lifecycle states, reconciliation, exception handling, sanctions screening, RFIs, or SLAs.

Why this role matters
  
  
Managed Payments is a core part of Circle’s strategy to make stablecoin-powered payments accessible to businesses beyond crypto-native customers. Customers increasingly need complete payment programs that allow them to accept funds, manage balances, convert across assets, and disburse globally without assembling wallets, banking partners, liquidity providers, compliance systems, and payout networks themselves. As Senior Product Manager, you will help turn that complexity into an integrated customer experience and scale Managed Payments into a reliable, global, enterprise-grade product.
  
  
*Circle is on a mission to create an inclusive financial future, with transparency at our core. We consider a wide variety of elements when crafting our compensation ranges and total compensation packages.*
*Starting pay is determined by various factors, including but not limited to: relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and other business and organizational needs. Please note that compensation ranges may differ for candidates in other locations.*

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About WorkIndia**

WorkIndia is India’s largest blue- and grey-collar hiring platform, built with a clear purpose: to provide meaningful livelihoods to 23.7 crore blue-collar individuals across India.

WorkIndia helps millions of job seekers connect with employers across the country. On the employer side, WorkIndia serves tens of thousands of businesses every month, enabling them to discover, evaluate, and hire relevant candidates at scale.

About the Product Organization

Our product teams focus on building long-term business outcomes across multiple employer journeys. Broadly, our employer-side charter spans:

* **Hunting:**
  Focuses on acquiring and converting new employers into paying customers through strong product-led growth and onboarding experiences.
* **Farming:**
  Focuses on helping existing employers succeed consistently by improving retention, expansion, and operational scalability through product systems.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**Product Manager with 3–5 years of experience**
to work on Employer Acquisition within the Hunting charter, owning end-to-end growth, conversion, and user experience.

You will define what to build, validate it through experimentation, and work with cross-functional stakeholders to ship impactful products.

This role requires strong execution ownership, first-principles thinking, user empathy, data fluency, and the ability to lead cross-functional teams to deliver measurable outcomes.

What You’ll Do

1. Ownership

* Own the product roadmap, driving growth, retention, UX, and funnel performance.
* Translate business goals into a clear roadmap and product priorities.
* Identify high-impact opportunities to improve conversion, activation, and user experience.
* Balance short-term execution with the long-term health of the product.

2. User Thinking & Product Judgment

* Develop a deep understanding of user needs, behaviours, and pain points.
* Ensure product decisions are grounded in real user outcomes.
* Translate user insights into scalable product improvements.
* Advocate for user impact while balancing business constraints.

3. Business & Product Leadership

* Own business outcomes for the product, not just individual features.
* Connect product decisions to measurable business impact.
* Partner with business teams to ensure product strategy reflects business goals.
* Influence cross-functional priorities and drive alignment with partner teams.

4. Execution & Systems Thinking

* Write clear PRDs with well-defined goals, scope, and success criteria.
* Design and run A/B experiments to validate major bets, including sizing, rollout percentage, and result analysis.
* Drive high-quality execution by working closely with Engineering and Design teams through to launch.
* Identify recurring product problems and propose scalable solutions rather than one-off fixes.
* Anticipate risks and proactively adjust plans.

5. Data & Decision-Making

* Use data to drive prioritisation and product problem discovery.
* Leverage analytics and experimentation to validate hypotheses.
* Own product metrics and outcomes end-to-end.
* Distinguish meaningful business outcomes from vanity metrics.

6. Cross-Functional Leadership

* Collaborate closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Customer Experience (CX), Sales, and Marketing to ship and scale products.
* Create clarity in ambiguous situations and resolve trade-offs constructively.
* Lead through influence with peers and cross-functional partners.

What We’re Looking For

* 3–5 years of Product Management experience.
* Experience in marketplace or consumer internet products is preferred.
* Proven experience designing and running end-to-end A/B experiments, including sizing, rollout percentage, and result analysis, in close collaboration with Design.
* A track record of shipping user-facing features that have delivered measurable results.
* Strong data fluency and the ability to use data for prioritisation and storytelling.
* Comfort operating in ambiguous environments.

Team & Reporting

* **Reports to:**
  Group Product Manager
* **Key Stakeholders:**
  Business, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Analytics, and Sales.

Why Join WorkIndia?

* **Impact:**
  Be part of a mission-driven company that impacts millions of lives every day.
* **Growth:**
  Work in a high-ownership environment where your initiatives directly shape the company’s growth and culture.
* **Location:**
  HSR Layout, Bangalore.

Bureau is a unified risk decisioning platform for Compliance, Fraud, and Transaction risks. Our platform is a single decision-making engine, powered by a 1 billion+ identity knowledge graph. Over 150 Banks, fintechs, retailers, and digital platforms use Bureau to verify identities faster and stop fraud earlier globally.

Bureau has raised $50M+ from renowned Silicon Valley and global investors including Sorenson Capital and PayPal Ventures and is expanding rapidly from APAC to Americas, Europe, and beyond.

**Why Bureau?**

Bureau is building the infrastructure that makes digital identities and transactions safe and trustworthy for billions of people. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is real.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, build systems from scratch, and care deeply about turning strategy into execution. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won't be your place. If you want to shape how a scaling global company operates—keep reading.

**About the Role: Product Manager - RASP**

You will own Bureau RASP (Runtime Application Self-Protection). It is a rare chance to take a category-defining security product from launch to scale.

* Sophisticated mobile fraud now executes inside the app itself. Bureau RASP answers with a four-layer Zero Trust framework embedded in the customer's app:
* Application integrity: code obfuscation, anti-tampering and anti-debugging, powered by XVM, our proprietary virtualization engine.
* Runtime and environment: detection of root, jailbreak, emulators, cloned apps, hooking and overlay attacks.
* Network and data channel: protection against MITM, packet sniffing, geo spoofing and VPN or proxy bypass.
* Visibility and policy: monitor, warn or block per threat from a dashboard, with immutable audit logs.

It is built at the OS level, goes live in minutes with no code changes, and feeds runtime signals into Bureau's Graph Identity Network. You will decide where it goes next.

**What you’ll be doing**

* Own the RASP vision, strategy and roadmap across Android and iOS.
* Track the mobile threat landscape and turn new attack patterns into shipped protections.
* Partner with security, SDK and platform engineers to deliver detections that are accurate, hard to bypass and light on app performance.
* Shape the customer experience: zero-code onboarding, the policy engine, alerts and audit reporting.
* Connect RASP signals with Device Intelligence, Behavioural Biometrics and the Graph Identity Network to create value no standalone RASP can match.
* Work with sales, solutions and marketing on positioning, pricing, demos and competitive wins.
* Spend time with CISOs, fraud heads and app teams at banks, fintechs and e-commerce firms to learn what they need.
* Define success metrics such as adoption, detection efficacy, false positives and integration time, and report on them.

**What You’ll Bring**

**Must have**

* 4-6 years in product management, with at least 2 years on a B2B security, fraud or mobile SDK product.
* Working knowledge of mobile app security: Android and iOS internals, reverse engineering, rooting, hooking and tampering.
* Comfort going deep with engineers on technical trade-offs, and going wide with customers on business outcomes.
* A record of taking a product from early release to enterprise adoption.
* Clear writing and sharp prioritisation.

**Good to have**

* Experience with RASP, app shielding, device fingerprinting or mobile threat defence.
* Exposure to BFSI or fintech customers and regulatory expectations for app security.
* An engineering or security research background.

**Our Culture**

* We hire self-motivated people and get out of their way
* We value performance, not hours worked
* Speed, ownership, and impact matter most

**Compensation**

* Competitive salary + potential equity
* Health benefits, flexible PTO, learning budget

jobs.description:

**Must have skills required:**
