**Nubra is Looking for:******
**Job Description:**
**Nubra | Product Manager, Core Trading**
**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
**Experience:**
3 to 6 years
  
  
**Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**Team:**
Product
  
  
**About Nubra:**
Nubra is a trading platform for people who take trading seriously, whether they scalp index options on expiry day or run multi-leg strategies over weeks. We've built Smart Flexi Orders, multi-strike charts, tick-level option chain data, a multi-leg strategy builder, smart watchlists, automation APIs, and flexible collateral management, and we're still early in what we want the product to become.
  
  
Most of our users have tried other platforms before us. They know exactly what breaks at 9:15 AM, which order types are missing, and how many taps it takes to adjust a position when the market moves against them. Our job is to make those moments better. You can see the product at nubra.io.
  
  
**The role:**
You'll own the roadmap for the parts of Nubra that traders use every single session: order placement and execution, the option chain, the strategy builder, charts, and our automation APIs. You'll work day to day with engineering and design, and closely with compliance and risk, since almost everything we ship has a regulatory angle. This is a hands-on role. You'll write the specs, sit in on technical discussions about latency and data feeds, look at the numbers yourself, and talk to traders every week.
  
  
Coming from e-commerce or D2C? We'd like to hear from you. Some of the best product thinking for a trading app comes from people who have built checkout flows, high-volume order systems, or products where a few seconds of delay costs real money. What we need from you is a genuine interest in markets and the willingness to get fluent in options and derivatives quickly. If you already trade on the side, even better.
  
  
**What you'll be responsible for:**- Roadmap and product direction:
- Own the roadmap for order types, option chain, strategy builder, charts and automation APIs.
- Decide what we build next and, just as often, what we don't. Be able to explain the reasoning to the team.
- Keep a close eye on other trading and investing platforms in India and abroad, and know where we're ahead and where we're behind.
- Building and shipping:
- Turn trader workflows into clear specs that engineers can build from without a dozen follow-up calls.
- Work with engineering on the trade-offs that matter in trading: speed, reliability, and accuracy of data under heavy market load.
- Work with design so that complex features (multi-leg orders, margin, Greeks) feel simple to use.
- Plan releases carefully. A bug in an order flow is not the same as a bug in a settings page.
- Users and data:

* Speak with active traders regularly through calls, support tickets, community channels and usage data.
* Define what success looks like for each feature and track adoption, retention, order success rates and trading behaviour.
* Run experiments where it makes sense and be honest about results when something doesn't work.
* Compliance and risk:

+ Work with compliance and risk teams so that new features meet SEBI and exchange requirements from day one, not as an afterthought.
+ Understand how margin, collateral and risk checks affect the user experience, and design around them sensibly.

**Your first six months, roughly:**

* Month 1: Use the product the way our users do, with real trades if you're comfortable. Read support tickets, sit with engineering, and get to know the order lifecycle end to end.
* Months 2 to 3: Take ownership of one feature area and ship your first meaningful improvement. Set up the metrics you'll use to judge it.
* Months 4 to 6: Own the roadmap for your area, with a clear view of priorities for the next two quarters and the user evidence to back them.

**What we're looking for:**

* 3 to 6 years of product management experience in trading, broking, fintech, capital markets, e-commerce or D2C.
* You've shipped consumer products end to end, ideally ones with high transaction volumes, real-time flows or demanding power users.
* You're comfortable with data. You can write or read a query, build a funnel, and tell the difference between a real trend and noise.
* You understand trading concepts such as order types, options, derivatives and market data, or you're clearly on your way there.
* You write clearly and can get engineering, design, compliance and business teams to agree on a plan.
* You're interested in markets. Not as a line on your CV, but because you actually find them interesting.

**Good to have:**

* Personal trading experience, especially in F&O.
* Prior work at a broker, exchange or prop trading firm.
* Experience with options or derivatives platforms specifically.
* Working knowledge of SEBI regulations and NSE/BSE rules.
* A background in analytics or quant, or experience with real-time data systems.
* Experience building payments, checkout or other high-trust flows where conversion and reliability both matter.

**How we work:**
We start with the user. Here that means thinking like a trader. If you can't explain why a trader would care, it probably doesn't belong on the roadmap. We move quickly. Markets change fast and so do our users' expectations. We'd rather ship, learn and fix than wait for a perfect version.
  
  
We use data, and we make calls. Numbers inform our decisions, but we don't hide behind them. Sometimes you have to back your judgement. We own outcomes. Shipping a feature isn't the finish line. Whether it helped traders is what counts.

jobs.title: Project Delivery and Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**The Role**

We're looking for a Project Delivery and Customer Success Manager to lead the delivery of condition monitoring and predictive maintenance projects across India. To begin with, you'll deliver a portfolio of large-scale ecoCMS and ecoPITCH installations. As these projects move into ongoing monitoring services, your role will grow into technical account management, owning the long-term customer relationship, renewals and growth across the installed fleet.

If you enjoy turning contractual commitments into clear delivery plans, working closely with customers and seeing projects through from purchase order to a smoothly running service, we'd love to hear from you.

**What you'll do**:

As Project Delivery and Customer Success Manager, you'll own delivery from purchase order handover through to long-term service, including:

* Taking ownership of projects after purchase order receipt, ensuring a complete handover from sales.
* Building and maintaining project schedules, resource plans, budgets, risk registers and action trackers.
* Coordinating supply chain teams to deliver sensing hardware and equipment to customer sites on schedule.
* Planning installation and commissioning with engineering and field teams, confirming site readiness and safety requirements before mobilisation.
* Completing commissioning records, customer training and formal acceptance or handover.
* Working with analytics and software teams to set up monitoring services, data connectivity and reporting, and ensuring a smooth transition into ongoing service.
* Acting as the primary customer contact during delivery, leading kick-off meetings, progress reviews and escalations.
* Tracking contractual milestones, supporting timely invoicing and following up with customers on payment queries.
* Monitoring project costs and performance, escalating potential overruns, and closing projects with lessons learned captured.
* Acting as the long-term technical and commercial contact for assigned customers, tracking renewals and service extensions in coordination with sales.
* Identifying and qualifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities, preparing account plans and maintaining records in Salesforce.
* Capturing customer feedback and market insights to inform product and regional strategy.

**What you'll bring:**

*Required*

* An engineering degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechatronics, Renewable Energy Engineering or a closely related discipline.
* 5-8 years of experience in technical project delivery, engineering services, commissioning or customer-facing project management.
* Experience coordinating hardware supply, site execution and ongoing technical services across multiple teams.
* A track record of managing customer commitments, schedules, technical issues and commercial milestones.
* Strong technical understanding and the confidence to engage with engineering, field service and analytics teams.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with sound judgement in handling customer expectations and escalations.
* Strong planning and follow-through across several concurrent projects.
* Experience working with overseas offices and teams across different time zones.
* Commercial awareness, including contractual scope, invoicing milestones and payment dependencies.
* Willingness to travel to customer offices and wind farm sites across India.

*Preferred*

* Experience in the wind energy industry, particularly turbine systems, operations and maintenance, or condition monitoring.
* A recognised project management qualification.
* CRM experience, and exposure to pre-sales, proposals or key account support.
* The ability to build trust with senior customer stakeholders and spot opportunities beyond the current scope

**How we'll measure success**

* Projects delivered safely, on schedule and within agreed scope and budget.
* Timely installation, commissioning and customer acceptance, with monitoring services running smoothly.
* Prompt invoicing and collection against payment milestones.
* Customer satisfaction, renewals and a qualified pipeline of upsell and fleet extension opportunities.

**About ONYX**

ONYX Insight is a growing technology and engineering organization in the renewable energy sector. Every day we monitor the performance of 32,000-plus wind turbines in 45+ countries, giving owner-operators the clarity and confidence to maximize reliability, minimize downtime, and increase annual energy production.

ONYX Insight is part of the Macquarie Group. Macquarie is a global financial services group operating in 34 markets in asset management, leasing and asset financing, market access, commodity trading, renewables development, specialist advisory services, capital raising and principal investment. The diversity of Macquarie Group operations, combined with a strong capital position and robust risk management framework, has contributed to a 54-year record of unbroken profitability.

For any further information, or to understand our products and services better, please feel free to look through our website: https://onyxinsight.com/ (https://onyxinsight.com/)

ONYX Insight is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Sr Business Analyst - Product Owner At Thermo Fisher Scientific, we develop innovative software solutions that enable our customers to advance science and improve human health. It is a close-knit, collaborative, cross-functional environment where Product Management, Software Engineering, Software Verification & Validation, Quality, and other functions work together to deliver high-quality products. The software team is tasked with applying industry best practices to the definition, design, development, verification, validation, and delivery of world-class software products for clinical and research settings. We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Sr Business Analyst - Product Owner who will serve as the primary liaison between the Product Management team and the Software Engineering and Software V&V teams. This individual will translate product and customer needs into clear, complete, testable, and implementation-ready requirements and user stories so that Development and V&V teams have a common understanding of intended product behavior. The Product Owner will act as the single point of contact for functional understanding of the product and will own the quality and completeness of requirements throughout the software development lifecycle. You are excited and passionate about participating in an Agile/SCRUM setting to meet customer expectations and continuously drive quality and delivery improvements. You are comfortable working with technical and business stakeholders, facilitating decisions, identifying gaps, and constructively challenging assumptions. You do not stop at identifying problems; you develop practical proposals, build cross-functional alignment, drive actions to closure, and use meaningful metrics to demonstrate measurable improvement in requirement quality, defect prevention, and product delivery. Essential Functions:
  
  

* Serve as the primary liaison between Product Management, Software Engineering, and Software V&V, ensuring a common understanding of product requirements, workflows, priorities, and expected system behavior.
* Translate product requirements, customer needs, business objectives, scientific workflows, and regulatory considerations into clear Epics, Features, User Stories, and Acceptance Criteria that can be independently understood and executed by Software Development and V&V teams.
* Own the functional quality and completeness of software requirements throughout the product development lifecycle and ensure requirements are clear, consistent, testable, traceable, and sufficiently detailed before implementation begins.

jobs.title: Product Owner (Packaging industry/domain)
jobs.description:
**Job purpose:**

The Product Owner is the execution arm of the product team and is accountable for translating product direction, roadmap initiatives, and customer needs into clearly defined, prioritised, and deliverable work for Agile development teams. The role owns the product backlog and sprint-level execution, ensuring that development teams understand what needs to be built, why it matters, and how successful delivery will be validated.

**Core responsibilities:**

Product Backlog and Prioritization

* Own, maintain, groom, and prioritise the product backlog, ensuring alignment with product goals, customer needs, business value, and delivery dependencies.
* Lead backlog refinement and ensure items are clearly defined, appropriately sized, prioritised, and ready for development.
* Assess feature requests, enhancements, defects, and competing demands; recommend sequencing and trade-offs in collaboration with the Product Manager.

Requirements and User Stories

* Translate roadmap initiatives and customer or business needs into epics, user stories, workflows, business rules, and clear acceptance criteria.
* Break down complex initiatives into manageable increments that can be delivered and validated through Agile sprints.
* Clarify functional behaviour, use cases, edge cases, and dependencies for Engineering and QA.
* Review completed work against acceptance criteria and confirm whether the agreed requirements have been met.

Agile Delivery and Team Enablement

* Work as the product domain expert and primary point of contact for the development team on backlog scope and requirement clarification.
* Participate actively in sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and other relevant Agile ceremonies; support the team in maintaining sprint-level momentum.
* Monitor sprint goals, backlog readiness, scope changes, and cross-team dependencies, escalating risks through the appropriate channels.
* Partner with Engineering and QA to support feature validation, quality, and delivery against agreed priorities.

Customer and Stakeholder Collaboration

* Work with Product Managers and relevant customer-facing teams to understand customer feedback and translate it into actionable product backlog items.
* Drive early feedback on new features and incorporate validated insights into backlog refinement and prioritization.
* Communicate priorities, scope decisions, requirement changes, and delivery expectations clearly to cross-functional stakeholders.
* Build alignment where stakeholders have competing needs, using product priorities and customer value to guide recommendations.

Continuous Improvement and Senior-Level Contribution

* Identify opportunities to improve story quality, backlog health, team collaboration, and product delivery practices.
* Use delivery and quality feedback to identify recurring requirement gaps, reduce avoidable rework, and improve sprint readiness.
* Share product domain knowledge and provide guidance or mentorship to less experienced Product Owners and team members, where applicable.

Role Focus and Responsibility Boundaries

* Maintain focus on product backlog ownership, requirement clarity, and sprint-level product execution in alignment with the Product Manager/CPO.
* Tier 2 support and technical triage are owned by Support/DevOps teams; project management and Scrum Master responsibilities by Delivery roles; customer demos and training by Enablement/Presales; and code contribution by Development teams.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Required experience and skills:**

* 8+ years of experience in Product Ownership, product delivery, software product development, or a closely related role, with substantial hands-on Product Owner experience.
* Mandatory: Relevant experience in the Packaging industry/domain, with specific exposure to CLF (Cartons, Labels & Flexibles). Understanding of packaging workflows, products, and industry-specific business processes is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience owning and prioritizing product backlogs for software products, ideally within a global SaaS or enterprise software environment.
* Strong capability in writing epics and detailed user stories, defining measurable acceptance criteria, and translating customer needs and roadmap initiatives into development-ready work.
* Proven experience working with Agile/Scrum development teams and contributing effectively to sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Ability to prioritize competing requirements by considering customer impact, business value, product priorities, effort, and dependencies.
* Experience working closely with Product Managers, developers, QA, Support, Implementation, and other cross-functional stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle, Agile delivery practices, and product quality/acceptance processes.
* Ability to act as a domain expert for delivery teams, resolve requirement ambiguity, facilitate decisions, and communicate scope and priority changes effectively.
* Experience with JIRA and familiarity with Confluence, Agile boards, backlog tools, and customer feedback tools.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, organization, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, globally distributed SaaS business.
* Experience mentoring colleagues or improving product ownership practices is an advantage.
* Business-level English proficiency (written and verbal) required.

jobs.title: Product Owner, Workday HELP (Case & Knowledge Management)
jobs.description:
The Pitch
  
  
As Product Owner for Workday HELP, you’ll own how our employees get answers and resolve HR issues: the cases, the knowledge, and the agents that make both smarter. You’ll implement, break things in sandbox, decide what ships, and turn Workday’s newest AI features into something employees actually use. This is a hands-on IC role. You will configure, test, and launch, not manage a backlog from a distance. And the exciting part: you will continue your consulting journey as we roll the implementation to our portfolio companies across the globe. Also, Workday is shipping AI faster than most teams can evaluate it. We want someone who gets excited about that, not overwhelmed by it.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  
**Own and implement Workday HELP**

* Lead end-to-end implementation of Case Management: case categories, case types, routing, SLAs, escalation paths, security, and integrations
* Build and run Knowledge Management: article structure, authoring and approval workflows, audience targeting, and content lifecycle
* Own the HELP product roadmap, backlog, and release readiness, including triaging each Workday bi-annual release for what matters to us

**Experiment With What’s Next**

* Evaluate and pilot new Workday AI capabilities as they arrive, including Illuminate and self-service agents
* Run structured experiments: define the hypothesis, configure in sandbox, test with real scenarios, and measure results
* Make clear, evidence-backed recommendations on what to adopt, defer, or skip
* Help shape our agent-led self-service approach, from deflection to guided resolution

**Make it measurable**

* Define the metrics for HR service delivery: case volume, resolution time, deflection, knowledge usage, and employee satisfaction
* Build case analytics and dashboards that show leaders what is working and where to act next

**Work across the Workday ecosystem**

* Partner with Core HCM, Talent, Recruiting, and Payroll teams so HELP works smoothly with the rest of the platform
* Work with People Operations, HR Centers of Excellence, and IT on process design, content ownership, and change management
* Coordinate with Workday and implementation partners on features, defects, and early-adopter programs

What You Bring
  
  
**Must-haves**

* Hands-on Workday HELP implementation experience. This is non-negotiable. You have taken Case Management and/or Knowledge Management from design to go-live
* Strong Core HCM background. You understand worker data, business processes, security, organizations, and how HELP depends on all of it
* Experience as a product owner, functional lead, or senior consultant who owns configuration, not just requirements
* Ability to translate HR service needs into clear user stories, configuration designs, and test plans
* Strong stakeholder communication across HR, IT, and business teams

**Strong plus**

* Experience implementing or piloting Workday self-service agents or Illuminate AI features
* Case management analytics experience (Workday reporting, people analytics, or dashboards on case data)

**What Makes You a Top Candidate**

* Experience in Peakon, Learning, or Journeys. We want someone who sees how HELP connects to the wider employee experience, such as a Journey that triggers a case or Peakon feedback that reshapes knowledge content
* Workday certifications in HCM or related modules
* Prior experience in a shared services or global HR environment

You’ll Thrive Here If You
  
  

* Treat every new Workday release like a gift basket and open it immediately
* Are comfortable saying “that didn’t work, here’s why, here’s what we do instead”
* Prefer building and testing over writing 40-page decks
* Care about the employee on the other end of the case, not just the configuration
* Can make a judgment call with 80% of the information

Why This Role
  
  

* To bring HELP to life, hands on.
* Early access to evaluating Workday’s AI roadmap, with real influence on what we adopt
* A role built around experimentation, not maintenance
* Visible impact: every employee touches HELP
* Opportunity to grow into broader People Technology and AI-in-HR leadership as our platform scope expands

jobs.title: Associate Manager, Product-Tech, Central
jobs.description:
**About The/Nudge Institute**
**The/Nudge**
is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals, and youth across rural development, agriculture, skilling, and economic inclusion, in partnership with 15+ central and state governments.
  
  
Our economic inclusion journey towards serving 25 million Indians spans 10 states and currently reaches over 1.5 million people. Through our incubator, accelerator, and grand challenges, we have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs, including Forbes 30 Under 30 honorees, Earthshot Prize winners, and nationally recognized changemakers.
  
  
Founded with the support of 130+ eminent philanthropists, 40+ corporates, and 15+ foundations, The/Nudge is working towards a poverty-free India, within our lifetime.
  
  
**About This Role**
The/Nudge is building its own technology products to run the organisation better and to deliver programmes at scale. These include internal platforms our 400+ team members use day to day, and tools that support our programme and field teams. We build fast and in-house, using AI-assisted development tools and LLMs.
  
  
We are looking for an Associate Product Manager to own products end to end: from understanding what users need, to shaping the solution, shipping it, and driving adoption. You will work closely with leadership, programme teams, strategy and operations teams, and with the engineers who build our products. This role suits someone who wants hands-on product ownership early in their career, in an organisation where technology directly serves social impact.
  
  
**What will you do?**

* Discover the problem: Work with internal teams and end users to understand their workflows and pain points through interviews, observation, feedback and usage data. Turn what you learn into clear problem statements.
* Define the product: Write product requirement documents (PRDs), user stories and acceptance criteria. Make sure every feature has a clear purpose, scope and measure of success.
* Prioritise the roadmap: Maintain the product backlog and roadmap. Weigh user impact, effort, risk and organisational priorities, and explain trade-offs clearly to stakeholders.
* Build with engineering and AI: Work hands-on with developers, interns and AI-assisted development tools to design, build and iterate on features. Translate requirements into precise, well-scoped instructions.
* Test before release: Plan and run user acceptance testing, coordinate beta testers, and track bugs and fixes through to closure. Protect live products from regressions.
* Launch and drive adoption: Plan rollouts, write launch communications, run demos and training sessions, and create user guides so that products are actually used.
* Measure what matters: Define and track product metrics such as adoption, usage and user satisfaction. Use the data to decide what to build, fix or retire next.
* Keep things documented: Maintain product documentation, decision logs and release notes so the products can scale and be handed over smoothly.
* Grow the product practice: Help bring a product-first, AI-first way of working to new initiatives as The/Nudge builds more products in the future.

**Who are we looking for in this role?**

* A degree in engineering, computer science, business, economics or a related field. Strong candidates from other backgrounds who can show product thinking are welcome to apply.
* 5+ years of overall experience in product management, business analysis, consulting, technology implementation or software engineering. Experience shipping a product or feature that real users adopted is a strong plus.
* Clear structured thinking: the ability to break a messy problem into its parts and write it up crisply.
* Comfort with data: spreadsheets are a must; basic SQL or a dashboarding tool is a strong plus.
* Hands-on familiarity with AI tools and large language models (LLMs), and curiosity about how they can be used to build products faster.
* Enough technical understanding to work confidently with engineers: how web apps, databases and APIs fit together. You do not need to be a developer.
* Excellent communication with non-technical users, from senior leadership to field teams. You can explain a feature simply and listen well to feedback.
* An ownership mindset: you follow a feature through to adoption, not just to release.
* A strong alignment with our mission to leverage technology for large-scale social impact.

**Good To Have**

* Experience building with no-code, low-code or AI-assisted development tools.
* Exposure to internal tools, ERP, CRM or HRMS systems.
* Experience in the social sector, or working with government or field programmes.

***Please note:***
This is an onsite, full-time role based in our Bengaluru office. We are dedicated to building a dynamic in-office culture and require all team members to work from the office.
  
  
*We aspire to be an inclusive and diverse organisation and encourage qualified individuals irrespective of their religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, or any other dimension of identity, to apply.*

**Job Title:**
Executive Product Owner - Enterprise Knowledge
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
**Business & Team:**
The Enterprise Knowledge Domain is a newly established capability and a foundational pillar of the Group's artificial intelligence strategy. The team will define how organisational knowledge is structured, governed, connected and made available across the enterprise. It will work closely with engineering, architecture, data, scientific and business communities to create trusted knowledge foundations that support enterprise search, knowledge discovery and intelligent systems.
  
  
Within the domain, the Knowledge Fabric team builds and operates the federated context layer that connects these foundations to people and AI agents, and the Product Owner makes sure it is adopted and delivers value.
  
  
**Impact and Contribution:**
As Exec Product Owner for the Knowledge Fabric, you will own the fabric as a platform product. You will set the roadmap and prioritise the backlog across the context layer, retrieval and MCP services, knowledge controls, and the consumption experience for AI agents and the harnesses they run in, including Agents.CBA, CommbankOS, Microsoft Copilot Cowork and OpenAI Codex.
  
  
You will onboard the teams building enterprise agents, user agents and user-defined agents, and make sure the fabric meets their needs for relevance, speed, security and cost. You will define and track platform measures such as retrieval latency, relevance, token cost and entitlement conformance, and coordinate closely with the Chief Data Office, Chief AI Office and End User Experience teams to bring use cases and domains live on the Knowledge Fabric.
  
  
**You are a platform product leader who can make a complex technical capability simple, valuable and easy for other teams to adopt.**
The Knowledge Fabric is building world-leading knowledge management capabilities for our AI-powered colleagues and agents. Together, we will make trusted, permission-aware knowledge available to the AI agents that need it, through a single, consistent retrieval point.

* Own the product vision, roadmap and prioritised backlog for the Knowledge Fabric platform. Drive product exploration (e.g. using design thinking and analytics) and formulate hypotheses to validate product strategy / design.

* Lead the onboarding of consuming agent teams across multiple harnesses, with clear documentation, service expectations and support.
* Define and report platform KPIs, including latency, relevance, token cost, availability and entitlement conformance.
* Work with the Chief Engineer to balance new capability, reliability, security and technical debt.
* Ensure entitlements, fine-grained permissions and agent-specific access controls are reflected in product requirements and evidenced for risk stakeholders.
* Coordinate roadmaps and dependencies with the Chief Data Office, Chief AI Office, End User Experience and the Knowledge Domain products.
* Track and report progress in bringing use cases and domains live on the Knowledge Fabric. Manage the squad’s performance to defined objectives including OKR tracking, etc.
* Ensure all obligations across customer, regulatory, internal policy and process frameworks (e.g. GDF, PDDP, RiC) are fully met and satisfied. Identify, articulate and manage risks, dependencies and compliance across streams of work (e.g. customer propositions).

**Essential Skills:**

* Have owned technical platform, API or data products used by other engineering teams.
* Product strategy, vision setting, roadmap creation, and outcome-based prioritisation.
* Understand how AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation, graph network and LLM applications consume context, and what makes retrieval good.
* Ability to assess and implement build vs buy decisions to enable platform and capability build.
* Strong stakeholder engagement and product-thinking skills to translate business knowledge, policies, processes, and controls into reusable enterprise knowledge products.

* Use data and metrics to make product decisions and demonstrate value.
* Understanding of risk, governance, compliance, and responsible AI principles in regulated environments.
* Can align multiple teams with competing priorities towards a shared roadmap.

Bachelors or Master's Degree in any stream

**We’re looking for a Business Analyst**

Snabbit is India’s first Quick-Service App delivering home services in just 10 minutes through a hyperlocal network of trained and verified professionals. Backed by Elevation Capital, Nexus Venture Partners, and Lightspeed, Snabbit is redefining the home services space by combining speed, quality, and trust.

Founded by Aayush Agarwal, Snabbit is on a mission to make home services as seamless and instant as ordering groceries. We’ve already completed thousands of jobs with exceptional customer satisfaction — and we’re just getting started.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a sharp, analytical, and execution-oriented Business Analyst to help solve complex business problems and support data-driven decision-making across Snabbit.

You will work closely with cross-functional teams—including Operations, Marketing, Category, Product, Growth, and Finance—to identify opportunities, track business performance, improve processes, and drive high-impact initiatives. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with data, finding patterns, and converting insights into measurable business outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Analyse business performance across cities, categories, and customer segments.
* Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and performance trackers for key business metrics.
* Identify trends, gaps, and opportunities through structured data analysis.
* Translate complex datasets into clear, actionable recommendations for business teams.
* Work closely with Marketing, Operations, Product, Growth, Category, and Finance teams on strategic projects.
* Track metrics such as demand, fulfillment, customer retention, service quality, productivity, and unit economics.
* Conduct root-cause analyses to understand performance deviations and operational challenges.
* Support business planning, forecasting, target setting, and performance reviews.
* Design and evaluate experiments aimed at improving customer experience, operational efficiency, and business growth.
* Automate recurring reports and improve the accuracy and efficiency of decision-making processes.
* Take end-to-end ownership of analytical projects—from defining the problem to implementing and measuring solutions.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Business, or a related discipline.
* 4-6 years of experience in business analytics, strategy, operations, consulting, or a similar role.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a structured approach to ambiguous problems.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
* Working knowledge of SQL and experience analyzing large datasets.
* Familiarity with visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or Metabase.
* Strong business judgment and the ability to connect data insights with business outcomes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and operate effectively in a fast-paced startup environment.
* High ownership, attention to detail, and a bias for action.

**Good to Have**

* Experience in a consumer internet, marketplace, hyperlocal, logistics, or high-growth startup.
* Exposure to Python or other analytical tools.
* Understanding of marketplace metrics, customer funnels, operational efficiency, and unit economics.
* Experience working directly with senior business stakeholders.

**Functional Job Title : Billing Transformation –Business Analyst (Reporting - OAS) – AVP**
**Reports to : BTP VP**
**Department/ Division : Controllership, Bangalore**
**Background**
State Street has established a Global Billing Function, which is responsible for client billing set up and invoicing across all business lines and geographies globally at State Street. Organizationally, it combines all groups performing these activities globally, and also includes centers residing in State Street Shared Service locations in Poland, India and China. Billing Organization owns aspects of business-as-usual activities within billing areas and also drives process improvements and automation. Global Billing Function is in the process of migrating to a new technology platform which will be used for all business units and regions.
  
  
**Basic Purpose Of Job**
The Billing application Reporting Business Analyst AVP will support the business to develop new reporting capabilities. These reporting capabilities will provide new, valuable insights from data sources across the billing platform. Support enhanced reporting on key processes including Client Setup, data delivery and core billing.
  
  
**They Will Perform The Following Functions**
OAS Reporting
  
  

* Analyze and validate new business requirements for reporting platforms used by State Street for Billing function.
* Coordinate with requirement owners to understand and build BRD’s for new reports
* Execute data analysis which identifies reporting opportunities
* Build SQL and report layouts in collaboration with technology team
* Prepare test case for the scenarios which is part of report delivery and enhancement (Release)
* Support various product enhancements and improvements for production release milestone
* Document procedures and checklists to control activities and report status
* Attend Demo's from QA and raise issues if there are any gaps.
* Perform day to day activities of identified as part of Billing Transformation Program
* BUAT Test case Execution and Evidence documentation.

Management Reporting
  
  

* Provide reporting updates at the senior leadership level, including but not limited to, Unbilled & Billed AR Monthly Reporting, Billing Metrics, KPIs, Productivity Dashboard
* Strengthen reporting standards and significantly increase automation across existing reports by leveraging AI‑enabled tools to improve accuracy, timeliness, scalability, and control

**Work Experiences**

* Bachelor’s/Master’s Degree with 10 - 14 years of progressive experience preferably from Financial Services and Banking industry / institutions.
* Must have experience of Business Intelligence Tools (OBIEE, OAS)
* Strong experience in SQL and Advanced Excel
* Experience in ORMB preferred.
* Complex operational activities involving analysis and reporting of financial data
* Variance analysis of reference and financial data and reporting of insights
* Experience of writing BRD’s, Test cases and execution of test scenarios in relation to reporting and business intelligence.
* Knowledge on business or technical migration/conversion processes will be an added advantage

**Skills**
tices)
  
  

* Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interface effectively with individuals at various levels, both internal and external
* Analytical, with strong problem-solving abilities and creative resolution skills
* Ability to work on multiple topics in a fast-paced, high volume environment
* Strong Analytical skill set used for financial data comparisons, reconciliations and investigations
* Ability to remain organized, pay strict attention to detail, and meet critical deadlines within program schedule
* Detailed orientated with ability to consistently and accurately execute against operational processes and controls
* Ability to adapt to a changing environment and demands of transition of new clients
* Strong communication skills with ability to participate in or lead conference calls and present financial results to financial and non-financial audiences at various levels of seniority
* Pride of ownership with the ability to drive results within the Business
* Solid business knowledge as it relates to the financial services industry including Financial product and institution knowledge
* Self-motivated, self-assured, and self-managed

**About State Street**
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst
jobs.description:
**Job Description Summary**
The Business Analyst will work closely with Data Science, AI Engineering, Product Owners, and business teams to support the development and delivery of AI/ML and Agentic AI solutions.
  
  
The role involves understanding business requirements, translating them into detailed user stories, and collaborating with Data Scientists and development teams to ensure solutions meet business objectives.
  
  
The Business Analyst will support AI use case identification, data analysis, requirements documentation, model evaluation, and Agile delivery activities. The role requires strong analytical capabilities, technical understanding, and an interest in emerging AI technologies, particularly Generative AI and Agentic AI. The role also supports AI-specific non-functional requirements, Responsible AI controls, risk identification, and governance documentation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Business Requirements and Analysis
* Engage with business stakeholders to gather, analyse, and document requirements for AI/ML and Agentic AI solutions.
* Translate business needs into well-defined technical requirements for Data Science team, multiple Epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Work with Data Scientists and AI Engineers to understand business rules, data requirements, expected outputs, and solution workflows.
* Define business scenarios, exception handling, and success criteria for AI-driven solutions.
* Ensure requirements are clearly documented, testable, and aligned with business objectives.
* Data Science and Agentic AI Collaboration
* Work closely with Data Science teams to support the development and implementation of AI/ML models and Agentic AI workflows.
* Understand AI solution workflows, including data extraction, processing, validation, and decision-making.
* Support the definition of requirements for AI agents, including agent responsibilities, workflow orchestration, tool interactions, and human-in-the-loop processes.
* Collaborate with technical teams to identify data dependencies, integration requirements, and potential solution limitations.
* Assist in identifying opportunities for process automation and efficiency improvements using AI technologies.
* Data Analysis and AI Evaluation
* Support data analysis, data preparation, and validation activities required for AI/ML solutions.
* Coordinate with business teams to define sampling methodologies and prepare representative Golden Datasets for model training and evaluation.
* Work with Data Scientists to define evaluation criteria and business success metrics, including precision, recall, accuracy, and automation rates, where applicable.
* Support model output validation, error analysis, and identification of improvement opportunities.
* Analyse discrepancies between expected and actual AI outputs and coordinate corrective actions with relevant teams.
* Support business acceptance testing and ensure AI solutions satisfy agreed success criteria.
* Responsible AI, Risk & Governance
* Ensure requirements consider data privacy, security, bias, fairness, explainability, transparency, and appropriate human oversight.
* Work with Data Science, Security, Risk, and Compliance teams to identify, document, and track AI-related risks and mitigating controls.
* Support AI governance and model approval documentation, risk assessments, and auditability, including decision traceability, access controls, logging, and monitoring.
* Capture risks including hallucinations, data leakage, prompt injection, model drift, and unintended agent actions; document guardrails, human review, fallback, and escalation requirements in acceptance criteria.
* Technical Understanding, API Testing & NFRs
* Analyse existing systems, data structures, and workflows to support AI solution integration.
* Understand and document data schemas, data mappings, JSON, XML/XSD, and API integration requirements.
* Use Postman or similar API testing tools to inspect and validate API requests, responses, and integrations alongside engineering and QA teams.
* Prepare process flow diagrams, data flow diagrams, functional specifications, and technical requirement documentation.
* Define measurable AI/ML and GenAI-specific NFRs with architects and engineers, covering latency, scalability, reliability, security, output quality, robustness, monitoring, explainability, auditability, privacy, and human oversight.
* Maintain requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and project documentation using Jira and Confluence.

**Required Knowledge And Skills**
**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 5 years of professional experience as a Business Analyst, including requirements gathering, process analysis, user stories, acceptance criteria, stakeholder management, and Agile delivery for technology or data-driven projects.

**Business Analysis**

* Good understanding of business analysis principles, requirements gathering, and documentation.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.
* Ability to prepare detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, and process documentation.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience using Jira, Confluence, and Microsoft Excel.

**Technical And Data Skills**

* Understanding of data processing, data mapping, and data quality principles.
* Familiarity with JSON, XML, XSD, APIs, and system integrations.
* Familiarity with Postman or comparable API testing tools for request/response validation.
* Ability to understand data flow diagrams, system architecture, and technical workflows.
* Experience eliciting, documenting, and validating non-functional requirements, including AI/ML and GenAI-specific performance, quality, security, and monitoring needs.

jobs.title: Business Analyst II , RPE Agentic Solutions
jobs.description:
**Description**
We are looking for a curious, detail-oriented Business Analyst II to join our team. In this role, you will turn complex operational data into clear insights, define business requirements, and help drive continuous improvement across compliance and verification workflows. You'll collaborate with stakeholders across operations and product to identify gaps, measure performance, and support automation and process improvement initiatives.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Data Analysis & Technical Execution
* Extract, analyze, and interpret large datasets using SQL, Python, Hadoop/Hive, Redshift, Oracle, or NoSQL databases
* Perform diagnostic analysis, root cause analysis, variance analysis, and pattern identification
* Apply data transformations and statistical techniques to generate actionable insights
* Design and maintain automated reporting systems and dashboards
* Validate data quality, flag upstream issues, and maintain data integrity
* Build and implement KPIs with summarized visuals to track metrics globally
* Problem Solving & Decision Support
* Solve ambiguous business problems with limited guidance using analytical approaches
* Distinguish between one-way and two-way doors in decision-making processes
* Conduct comprehensive analysis to support business cases, product pilots, and strategic initiatives
* Provide diagnostic insights and recommendations that drive measurable business impact
* Navigate uncertainty and propose solutions when problems have less well-defined parameters
* Stakeholder Communication & Management
* Tailor communication to audience needs, presenting to leaders up to three levels above
* Translate complex analytical findings into clear formats for all stakeholder levels
* Facilitate productive dialogue, negotiate priorities, and establish shared understanding
* Proactively communicate project status, risks, and roadblocks to reset expectations
* Create plans, communicate requirements, and clarify success criteria
* Project Delivery & Execution
* Scope, drive, and deliver complex projects across multiple teams with minimal supervision
* Manage timelines effectively and proactively identify risks to deliverables
* Deliver consistently high-quality, well-documented work that answers business questions
* Incorporate best practices and set quality checks in all analytical work
* Balance tradeoffs between time, quality, and resources
* Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Partner with Product, Tech, Operations, and other stakeholders
* Act as bridge between different teams to deliver optimized solutions
* Collaborate with data engineering teams to automate processes and ensure data quality
* Prepare and deliver business requirements reviews to senior management
* Establish and maintain effective working relationships across teams
* Process Improvement & Strategic Contribution
* Identify and optimize business processes and data methodologies to improve efficiency
* Determine when solutions should be repeatable versus one-time and implement accordingly
* Build flexible, scalable solutions that anticipate business changes
* Contribute to team business strategy using deep business expertise
* Own items on team-level roadmap and begin to influence broader strategy
* Team Development & Leadership
* Mentor and develop junior analysts
* Participate in recruiting and interviewing for the team
* Share knowledge and optimize analytical best practices across the team
* Build trust through consistent delivery and proven business impact

**About The Team**
Relay Product Excellence's mission is to monitor Transaction Integrity for products supporting Identity Verification, Account Support, and Compliance across Carrier and Driver processes. Our team works at the intersection of risk management, regulatory compliance, and data-driven operations — partnering with product and technology teams to ensure the integrity and reliability of processes at scale.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience
* Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
* Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders
* Experience with SQL
* Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience partnering with executive-level leaders to identifying and solving business issues
